pr_title: GameEngine: add VFX Builder authoring window
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds the first ADR 0125 VFX Builder authoring surface inside the existing Editor process. The window opens project-local `*.vfx.json` assets, edits emitters and phase-ordered modules through `VfxAuthoringService`, saves canonical JSON, and uses service-provided inverse commands for undo/redo.

This request intentionally establishes the typed Builder foundation; preview viewport, gizmos, and dedicated curve/gradient controls remain follow-up VFX Builder work.
